programs.description: Ganesh, an elephant, watches his master being killed by three poachers. After many years, Ganesh can identify the killers while being in the service of a new master, Munna.
Karuna, a devotee of Lord Shiva, marries Pratap, a rich young man, but his family tortures her. Her life changes when Lord Shiva blesses her brother with a superpower.
Manohar and Uma are a happily married couple with two children. One day, Uma learns about her husband's extramarital affair and decides to leave him taking the kids along with her.
A young lawyer on the lookout for a fresh face for his music video meets a career-oriented banker. Soon, they fall in love and discover that they have completely opposing views about marriage.
Aba Gokhale, an elderly man who lives with his son and daughter-in-law, falls from the balcony. Subsequently, Inspector Maruti Nagargoje sets out to investigate the truth behind the accident.

Shriranga Deshmukh is frustrated with all the women in his life. However, when he gets back from his native place, he realises he has supernatural powers allowing him to listen to any woman's thoughts.
